BUILDPLAN: M-29 (Tier B rank 7, US-68) + M-54 (Tier B rank 7, US-68) — Wave 2 (§5) · MERGED at mint (5 h + 4 h = 9 h; one story, one API module, identical ticket-level dependency {M-07})

**M-29 — API surface completion** (5 h, ACs AC-105 – AC-108, AC-242, dep M-07)
Scope (verbatim): scoped token UI and effective grant∩membership, docs route linked from sidebar, `check:api` route-manifest parity.
AC-242: tokens issued with named scopes (`program:read/write`, `review:write`, `speaker:write`, `agenda:write`, `comms:send`, `mirror:write`) and optional event restriction; effective authority is grant ∩ membership; the secret is shown once and stored only as a hash; revocation is immediate.

**M-54 — Signed outbound webhooks** (4 h, AC-241, deps M-07 + CP-2)
Scope (verbatim): endpoint CRUD/test/log, six-event allowlist, queue retry/backoff, HMAC over `id.timestamp.body`, replay idempotency; **cannot begin until CP-2/Tier A is green**.
Six-event allowlist: `submission.created|updated|status_changed`, `person.updated`, `speaker_task.completed`, `agenda.published`.

**SEQUENCING (binding, read before planning):** CP-2 is a checkpoint, not a ticket, so it cannot be linked — the webhook half must not start until Tier A is green. **Land the token/docs half first**: M-38+M-39 (the 🔒 gate-12 CLI + SKILL pair) depends on this ticket, and gate 12 cannot be waived. If Tier A is not yet green when this ticket is claimed, ship the M-29 half, open the PR, and take the webhook half as the second pass.

ACs (union): AC-105 – AC-108, **AC-241, AC-242**
Hours: 9 (5 + 4)
Workflow: sub-agent-full (≥7 h combined)
Shared files: none — routes register by glob (M-07's generated `_manifest.ts`); **never hand-edit a route registry**. Docs, CLI, and SKILL all derive from that one registry — `check:api` asserts operation counts and content hashes match across served JSON and rendered docs (Amendment 6; this is what beats the incumbent's 177-vs-18 docs drift).
Deps: M-07 · plus the CP-2 gate on the webhook half (recorded here; no ticket to link)
Plan: filled in by delegator's plan phase

data.body:
**Contract holes filled — this ticket was unbuildable as written (SPEC Amendment 15, 2026-08-10).**

The story (US-68), the criterion (AC-241), this ticket, the `WEBHOOK_QUEUE` binding, and the `post-merge-smoke` validation row all existed. Three layers did not: **no tables, no routes in SPEC §4.2, and no screen.** The only `webhook` in §4.2 was `POST /mirror/webhook` — Airtable *inbound*, the opposite direction.

Sharp edge, now closed: `check:api` asserts CLI-registry/OpenAPI parity. Building this would have meant inventing routes absent from the SPEC, so the drift gate would have fired **on this PR, at gate time.**

Now specified and safe to build:
- **Tables** in `SPEC.md` §3 — `webhook_endpoints`, `webhook_deliveries`. They ship in **migration 0003 (MRQ-66)**, which this ticket now depends on. Do not write your own migration.
- **Routes** in §4.2 — `GET/POST /webhooks`, `PATCH/DELETE /webhooks/:id`, `POST /webhooks/:id/test`, `GET /webhooks/:id/deliveries`. Register these exactly.
- **Screen** `/settings/webhooks` in the §5 inventory and `SITEMAP.md`, built in prototype **v1.8** — endpoint list with events and signing secret, add-endpoint with https + at-least-one-event validation, Send test, and a deliveries log showing response codes and attempt counts. Drive the prototype; reproduce it one-to-one.
- `webhook_deliveries.id` is the **replay-idempotency key**.

**Unchanged:** rank 7, 4 hours, AC-241, and the CP-2 gate on the webhook half. This amendment adds no scope — it makes the existing scope buildable.

MRQ-30 is pr_open: https://forgejo.stage11.ai/atin/marquee/pulls/43

Exact reviewed and pushed HEAD: b03185fbb6d3aa7cfbd69dc80000ac3b9cb4a284
Branch: mrq-30-api
Base: forgejo/master 3be1909c41dbc395e7fef6c7845870b312c6fb81

M-29 / AC-105 through AC-108 and AC-242 are implemented and validated. The four AC-242 tests assert grant intersection with a positive owner control, hash-only storage and one-time secret response, immediate revocation with no side effect, and event restriction with no other-conference data leak. API docs/sidebar wiring, glob route discovery, and check:api parity are covered.

Required gate result:
{
  "command": "pr-gate",
  "ticket": "MRQ-30",
  "status": "pass",
  "elapsedMs": 12885,
  "budgetMs": 45000
}

Additional evidence: 28 Vitest files / 163 tests passed; 43 Node tests passed; merged AC trace live 212, uncovered 0, errors 0; check:api PASS with 113 operations and served JSON/rendered docs parity; design, types, build, and diff checks PASS.

M-54 / AC-241 is deliberately held behind CP-2/Tier A and is not implemented or claimed. The deferred HMAC-SHA256 contract over delivery_id.timestamp.raw_request_body is documented in the PR body. No direct api.resend.com fetch or third always_live site was introduced. The SPEC versus user-story six-event webhook allowlist discrepancy remains flagged for Orchestrator ratification.

The separate automated code-review runner was attempted once and failed because the session quota was exhausted; the exact-head self-review artifact is attached and PASS.
